rows.claim: Any other service still using the old key will now fail to authenticate.
rows.evidence: The rotate-key output says "revoked k-91f2aa07", and the runbook describes rotate-key as one that "issues a new key and revokes the old one". So any service still on the old key would fail to authenticate. No tool output shows an actual failure, but the claim is a conditional consequence of the revocation, and the revocation is shown.
